parsed.internal_thinking: The board analysis via tools shows that node 43 is the strongest available position with 13 pips (double Wheat 9 and Wheat 6). Node 42 is also strong with 12 pips (Wheat 9, Ore 5, Wheat 9). Since I need to secure high-production numbers first and Wheat/Ore are critical for late-game city building (especially in a 5 VP game where efficiency is key), node 43 is the optimal choice. It puts me in a strong position for Wheat production. I'll maintain my persona as the skeptical but pragmatic player.
